title: How to Apply for a New PAN Card (Form 49A)
summary: An Indian citizen can apply for a new Permanent Account Number (PAN) online through the Protean (NSDL) or UTIITSL official portal. The process involves filling Form 49A, uploading identity/address/birth proofs, paying the application fee, and verifying via Aadhaar OTP or physical document submission.
documents_needed: Proof of Identity (PoI): Aadhaar Card, Passport, or Voter ID
Proof of Address (PoA): Aadhaar Card, Electricity Bill, or Bank Account Statement (less than 3 months old)
Proof of Date of Birth (DoB): Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, or 10th Class Marksheet
Two recent passport-sized color photographs (if opting for physical mode)

steps.text: Visit the official Protean eGov (formerly NSDL) or UTIITSL PAN application portal.
steps.tip: Verify you are on https://www.tin-nsdl.com or https://www.utiitsl.com and not a third-party intermediary.

steps.text: Select Application Type as 'New PAN - Indian Citizen (Form 49A)' and choose your Category (usually 'Individual').
steps.tip: Keep your personal details (Full name, DoB, Email, Mobile) ready as per your Aadhaar records.

steps.text: Fill in the applicant details and generate the temporary Token Number.
steps.tip: Save the Token Number immediately to resume application if the session expires.

steps.text: Choose submission method: digital e-KYC & e-Sign (paperless via Aadhaar OTP) or physical forwarding of documents.
steps.tip: Aadhaar paperless mode is instant and does not require mailing physical documents.

steps.text: Provide AO (Assessing Officer) Code by selecting Indian Citizens, State, and City to view your jurisdiction.
steps.tip: The portal will automatically suggest the AO code once you pick your nearest Income Tax Ward/Circle.

steps.text: Pay the application fee online (approx. ₹107 for physical delivery in India, or ₹72 for e-PAN only).
steps.tip: Payment can be made using UPI, Net Banking, or Debit/Credit Card.

steps.text: Download the acknowledgment slip with the 15-digit acknowledgment number to track dispatch status.
steps.tip: e-PAN is usually issued to your registered email within 2 to 5 working days.

warnings.text: Ensure your name and date of birth match your Aadhaar card exactly.
warnings.reason: Mismatched demographic details will result in rejection of the e-KYC authentication step.

warnings.text: Beware of unofficial websites charging inflated fees exceeding ₹107.
warnings.reason: The standard official government processing fee for physical card dispatch is ₹107 inclusive of GST.
warnings.source: Protean eGov Technologies / Income Tax Department
